subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding for CobaltHealth trial — PO gating question
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@cobalthealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cobalthealth.com
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to kick off a 6‑week technical pilot. Procurement asked me to check whether we can onboard under an invoice-only flow for the trial (we don't have a formal PO process for ad-hoc pilots). The estimated spend for the trial is ~$11,500.

I attached our Statement of Work and a filled supplier intake. What we need from your side:
- Confirmation you can accept invoices without a PO for this one-time trial
- Any terms or routing instructions so our accounts payable can pay quickly
- Vendor tax info or W‑9 if required by your finance team

Happy to route through an internal approval if you need signoffs — let me know what documents we should sign.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Sr. Procurement Manager, CobaltHealth

Attachments:
- Cobalt_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 128KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@cobalthealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Hi team — FYI inbound from CobaltHealth (Alice) on a small pilot. They asked if we can do invoice-only (no PO) for this one-off engagement (~$11.5k). I filled out their vendor onboarding form and attached it.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: can Ops/Finance approve a temporary invoice-only routing for <$15k trials? What controls do you need?
- Laura: procurement side — any compliance or allowlist work required (vendors that bypass PO)?
- Vivek: any pricing/t&c caveats we should surface to the customer before we commit?

Proposed guardrails from my side: 90‑day exception window tied to this SOW, cap $15k, require vendor tax form + signed minimal SOW. If finance/procurement are okay, I'll confirm with Alice and get DocuSign for the SOW.

Attachments:
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Karthik / team — Finance ops here. We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under these conditions:

- Spend cap: $15,000 total for the pilot period
- Duration: exception valid for 90 days from the first invoice
- Required docs before first invoice: vendor W‑9 (or relevant tax form), completed onboarding form (I reviewed the PDF stub), and countersigned SOW (we need customer signature + vendor signature)
- Routing: invoices must be emailed to ap-payments@redwood.com with the subject line: CobaltHealth — Pilot Invoice — [Invoice #] and include the SOW reference RED-4582
- GL code: include project code PRJ-TRIAL-2027 in the invoice or we will return for rework

Operational notes:
- We will not create a formal PO in the ERP; instead, AP will tag invoices with the temporary exception flag and notify Procurement when the cumulative amount hits 80% of the cap.
- Escalation: if cumulative spend exceeds $15k or term extends beyond 90 days, this requires Procurement + Finance director signoff.

If Procurement (Laura) and Sales (Karthik) are aligned, Marissa will send the one‑time approval email and provide the DocuSign link to the customer.

Marissa Cole
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- onboarding-checklist.xlsx (referenced internally)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@cobalthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only path (no PO)

Thanks all — Procurement approves the temporary invoice-only onboarding for CobaltHealth under Marissa's conditions. A few additional points:

- Add the vendor to the procurement allowlist with tag: "one-time-pilot-2027"; Laura will own the entry and retention notes.
- Require minimum insurance attestation in the onboarding form (Alice: if you can't provide a certificate, a written attestation is acceptable for this pilot)
- Please ensure SOW explicitly references the $15k cap and 90‑day window so AP has a clear reference during invoice processing

Karthik: please confirm to Alice that we can proceed. Marissa: once you send the approval email and DocuSign link, cc procurement so the allowlist can be created.
